title: #370 Positive Aspects and Perspective
prompt: It is important to look at the positive aspects when discussing various subjects. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your view.

promptSegments.text: It is important to look at the positive aspects when discussing various subjects.
Give reasons and examples to support your view.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Positive views help build trust.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Positive views help people learn better.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Positive views help people learn better.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that adopting a positive perspective is beneficial for personal growth and social connections.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that adopting a positive perspective is beneficial for personal growth and social connections.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The benefits discussed include improved self-confidence and stronger relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The benefits discussed include improved self-confidence and stronger relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses how focusing on positive aspects helps individuals maintain a proactive mindset and drives positive change.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph discusses how focusing on positive aspects helps individuals maintain a proactive mindset and drives positive change.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph explains that presenting a positive perspective improves interpersonal relationships and group cohesion.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph explains that presenting a positive perspective improves interpersonal relationships and group cohesion.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the importance of focusing on positive aspects when addressing various subjects, using environmental sustainability as a case study.
keyArguments: Positive framing encourages proactive solutions and public engagement in environmental issues.
Focusing on positive aspects fosters collaboration and sustainable development.
